reasons.other-unique-constraint: Another target unique constraint conflicts with the expanded rows. Adjust the target schema or mapping.
reasons.multiple-identity-fields: This target has multiple identity fields requiring an explicit mapping.
reasons.invalid-field-name: Choose a nonblank top-level source identity field name.
reasons.target-key-conflict: Streams writing to this target require incompatible automatic matching keys. Use one matching key or separate targets.
reasons.ambiguous-source-id-field: Several expansions reaching this target use different source identity field names. Choose one name for this target.
reasons.key-representation-unsupported: The target key type cannot be verified to preserve source identifiers without loss. Use compatible key columns or an explicit mapping.

storage.cloudSetup: Configuration storage is supplied by the platform. Connect your Atlas cache and application databases.
storage.opSetup: Use one MongoDB or Atlas connection and three different database names. Test each layer before saving.
storage.tlsHelp: Standard mongodb:// and mongodb+srv:// URIs are supported. TLS verifies the server certificate and hostname. Client certificates and private keys are not supported.
storage.atlasHelp: Atlas requires public endpoints, the cluster egress IP in its access list, and TLS. Password authentication prefers SCRAM-SHA-256 and supports SCRAM-SHA-1 accounts. Keep authSource=admin.
storage.customCa: Custom CA for configuration and cache
storage.customCaHelp: Optional PEM certificate bundles, up to 64 KiB each. Custom CA-only connections for the default application database are outside this release. No private keys.
storage.distinctDatabases: Each layer needs a different database name.
storage.setupResultPending: Initialization is still running. Its request did not return a result; this page will keep checking the original operation.
storage.setupCommitHelp: Saving binds these databases to this cluster. A timeout may mean the operation is still running. Refresh its status before retrying.

initialization.title: Initializing your cluster
initialization.updatingSession: Updating sign-in. Initialization continues; the last confirmed progress is shown.
initialization.stale: Progress could not be refreshed. The last confirmed state is shown.
initialization.runtimeHelp: Preparing data connectors and checking required resources. A slow database connection can extend this step.
initialization.restored: Earlier completed steps were restored from saved configuration. Their previous durations are unavailable.
initialization.canLeave: You can close this page. Closing it does not cancel initialization. Reopen this Cluster from Cloud to see its progress.

opStage.PUBLISH_READY: Ready to create the first administrator

initialization.opCanLeave: You can close this page and return to this installation address. Saved settings are retained. After the automatic restart, use the new first-administrator credential from the installation capability file.

storage.setupCheckRetained: Runtime preparation is still in progress. This is the connection test completed before saving.
storage.managementHelp: Open the management address shown by the installation command on the server. For remote access, use an explicit secure tunnel. Storage and first-administrator writes require that dedicated channel.
storage.capabilityHelp: Enter the current credential from the owner-only capability file created by the installation command. It stays in this page only. After a restart or expiry, obtain a fresh credential through that command.
storage.loginHelp: Storage setup and sign-in are separate. Sign in again through the original entry to obtain a current session. Saved storage settings are retained.
storage.normalLoginHelp: Open the normal cluster service address and sign in with the account you created. This management channel does not serve ordinary sessions.
storage.adminUnknownHelp: Check status before trying again. If the account was created, use normal sign-in; do not create another administrator or reset the password.
storage.originalResultHelp: Keep this ID for a refresh or a later sign-in. An unknown result must be checked with the original ID before another attempt.

errors.authentication: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.permission: This credential cannot perform this action. Check its purpose and validity.
errors.conflict: The state has changed. Refresh and review it again before confirming.
errors.dependency: Storage is temporarily unavailable. Restore the original storage and refresh. Sign-in cannot bypass this dependency.
errors.request: The request was refused. Review the settings or check the original operation result before retrying.
errors.responseUnavailable: The server response could not be confirmed. Refresh status to check the original operation before retrying.
errors.network: The response could not be verified. Check the connection and the original operation result.
errors.databaseCredentials: The database rejected these credentials. Check the database username, password and authentication database.
errors.databasePermissions: This account does not have the required database permissions. Check read, write, index and transaction access on the selected database.
errors.databaseConnection: The database could not be reached. Check DNS, network access, the Atlas IP access list and TLS settings.

recovery.title: Recover runtime storage and pipelines
recovery.help: Cluster recovery prepares new runtime storage and leaves every affected pipeline stopped. Then preview and explicitly confirm a full rebuild for each pipeline, including its source and target requirements.
recovery.previous: Previous recovery operation ID, if requested by the server
recovery.noPipelines: No pipelines are included in this plan.
recovery.confirmHelp: I have reviewed this pipeline, its source full-load capability, models, and target handling, and explicitly confirm a new full rebuild. A changed scope needs a new preview.
recovery.clusterConfirmHelp: I have stopped and isolated every old cluster member using the deployment tools and verified that old source/target connections and in-flight writes have ended. I confirm this entire scope. The cluster checks local cleanup and storage identity; I am responsible for isolation across machines. All affected pipelines will remain stopped.
recovery.clusterComplete: Runtime storage is ready. Every affected pipeline remains stopped until you explicitly confirm its full rebuild. This does not mean its data or targets have recovered.
recovery.targets: Target handling for this full rebuild
recovery.executionFailed: This operation has not completed. Inspect the pipeline error. If its run failed, stop it before explicitly continuing this original operation.
recovery.stalePreview: The current inputs no longer match this preview. Check the original scope and preview it again before confirming.

policy.APPEND: Keep existing rows and apply the configured write mode.
policy.CLEAR: Clear the selected target tables before loading the full source again.
policy.FAIL: Refuse the full load if a selected target table already contains rows.

recovery.sharedHelp: Use both original identities from the storage diagnosis. The server determines the actual affected pipelines. Other shared logs and their readers continue to run.
recovery.sharedConfirmHelp: I have stopped and isolated the listed pipelines and the old shared capture on every machine, and verified that their old source/target connections and in-flight writes have ended. I confirm this exact scope. The affected pipelines will remain stopped and each needs an explicit full rebuild.
recovery.sharedComplete: The replacement shared log is ready. For each listed pipeline, use Stop with clear state, then explicitly start its full load. Other pipelines keep their state. The affected data and targets have not yet recovered.
recovery.sharedFailure: This original shared recovery has not completed. Inspect its error and recheck this same scope before confirming a changed preview.

transfer.title: Transfer configuration
transfer.help: Export selected resources and their required definitions in an encrypted package. Runtime state, business data and cluster keys are excluded. Keep the transfer key separately; it is never stored here.
transfer.confirmHelp: I confirm this default-target mapping and insertion of the checked configuration. Existing resources are not overwritten and pipelines will not start automatically.

phaseHelp.NOT_CONFIGURED: Test and save the databases before using the cluster.
phaseHelp.PREPARING: The original setup is being prepared. Saved database settings stay in place.
phaseHelp.RESTART_REQUIRED: Storage is saved. Restart through the installation command, then authorize first-administrator creation.
phaseHelp.FIRST_ADMIN_REQUIRED: Set a username and password for the first administrator.
phaseHelp.AUTH_READY: Authentication is available. Business services are still waiting for storage admission.
phaseHelp.READY: Runtime storage is admitted. Each layer below reports its own verification state.
phaseHelp.UNAVAILABLE: Restore the original storage and check again. Do not replace the binding or repeat installation.
phaseHelp.AWAITING_REBUILD_CONFIRMATION: Sign-in has been restored; business state has not. Review and explicitly confirm the rebuild.
phaseHelp.RECOVERING: Check the original recovery operation. Business access remains closed until recovery is verified.
phaseHelp.CLEANUP_REQUIRED: A previous attempt has not confirmed resource cleanup. Keep the original settings and check again.

storage.autoRetry: The status check could not complete. Retrying automatically; your original request has not been resubmitted.

storage.setupSavedHelp: The database settings are saved. The cluster is preparing its runtime.
storage.resumeSetupHelp: These databases are already bound. Use the original connection details to continue. If the previous result is uncertain, refresh its status first.

dataValidation.title: Data validation
dataValidation.description: Independently read direct one-to-one mappings from the saved Pipeline.
dataValidation.requestFailed: The validation request did not complete. Check its original state before retrying.
dataValidation.premise: Reliable full-check conclusions require completed initial synchronization and stable source and destination data. Otherwise results are read observations and do not establish a common-time snapshot.

schedule.title: Scheduled full validation
schedule.description: Schedule full runs using the saved validation configuration.
schedule.fiveFields: Minute · hour · day of month · month · day of week
schedule.syntaxHelp: Use five Unix fields. Day of month and weekday use OR. Missing local times are skipped; repeated local times run only at their first occurrence.
schedule.zoneHelp: Save an explicit IANA zone. The saved rule does not follow browser or execution-node time-zone changes.
schedule.retentionHelp: Keep 1–100 ended FULL runs; default 10. Failed, stopped and ended runs awaiting archival count toward the limit. Changing only retention preserves the schedule anchor.
schedule.previewRequired: Enter a rule and wait for a successful preview of these exact inputs before saving.
schedule.independent: Disabling prevents future scheduled starts and does not stop an admitted run. Stopping this run leaves the schedule unchanged. Enabling begins at a future occurrence, not immediately.
schedule.skips: Busy, late and missed occurrences are skipped without catch-up. Admission is checked again at the due time.
schedule.retentionConfirm: Change FULL retention from {{before}} to {{after}}. Older ended reports may be removed. This does not reset the schedule anchor.

dataValidation.definitionChanged: The saved definition changed or requires key review. Reload and explicitly review the full configuration before saving or starting.
dataValidation.readbackRequired: The original receipt could not be confirmed against the current saved task. Read back its state before continuing.
dataValidation.unknownSave: The save outcome is unconfirmed. Only retry the original save; do not start a new run yet.

bulk.title: Full validation settings
bulk.keysRequired: Confirm every source and destination key component.
bulk.keyConfirmation: Review recommended physical fields before saving. Saving confirms every participating pair. Exclusions affect only this validation, not synchronization.
bulk.unresolved: Some outputs have unresolved table scope. They are not known table pairs. Resolve or explicitly exclude them before saving; no partial scope is silently accepted.
bulk.discovery: Retained table names observed at {{time}}; server precheck validates the current selection.

reasons.unsupported-path: This stage supports direct one-to-one mappings only.
reasons.missing-discovery: No retained table names are available. Discover the source schema first.
reasons.mapping-limit: The selected scope exceeds the admitted table limit.

bulk.writeKeyUnknown: The Pipeline write key is unknown. Select the actual correspondence explicitly.
bulk.nextRun: Saved changes apply to later full runs. Existing runs and reports retain their original definition.

run.title: Full run status
run.independent: Stopping this run does not disable its schedule. Control reads retain the original operation; they never dispatch a new start.
run.unknown: The original run outcome is unconfirmed. Continue reading its original state.
run.notAdmitted: The original start was not admitted. No completed result is asserted for that request.
run.slotBusy: The FULL slot is busy or the original start is still unconfirmed.
run.otherAdmitted: Another command owns that exact start sequence. The original request did not win; controls show the stored run.

report.title: Full validation report
report.absent: This report is not yet born or is no longer retained. Absence is not a clean result.
report.premiseUnknown: The system does not verify the stable-data premise. These are read observations; confirm completed initial sync and both sides stable before drawing a reliability conclusion.
report.countOnly: Equal counts do not prove equal keys or contents.
report.searchKey: Search all observed record keys or IDs
report.noRetainedRecords: No retained problem records match. Only a completed report can state that no issues were observed.

results.COMPLETE_NO_ISSUES_OBSERVED: No differences observed in this completed full run
results.COMPLETE_WITH_OBSERVATIONS: Differences observed in this completed full run

history.title: FULL report history
history.retention: Ended FULL runs include failures, stops and pending archival. Retention follows the saved 1–100 limit.

record.title: Record details
record.readOnly: Retained read observations only. These facts do not establish a common-time snapshot or a confirmed synchronization fault.
record.samplesTruncated: Only bounded diagnostic samples are retained. Missing samples do not mean missing records, equal values or complete field coverage.
record.noMatchingFindings: No retained findings match this filter. This is not a clean-result conclusion.
record.keyMeaning: These are the complete normalized matching components and frozen physical field names. Actual returned identities remain attached to each retained side sample above; no returned identity is invented for absent samples.
record.valueUnavailable: The retained value cannot be shown in this structured view. Its original typed payload remains available.
record.mappingUnavailable: The record does not match this report’s frozen mapping.
record.fragment: Differing fragment near displayed UTF-16 position {{position}} (source, then destination)
record.waitForEnd: Retained record browsing is available after this run ends. The current run has no final conclusion.

kinds.TARGET_MISSING: Destination row not found in this read
kinds.TARGET_EXTRA: Destination row without a matching source row
